prompt: I need to create a professional investor pitch deck by combining content from multiple sources. Take the company overview from overview.txt, financial projections from quarterly_data.csv, team bios from team_profiles.json, and market analysis from market_research.docx. Use the existing corporate_template.pptx as the base design but customize it with our brand colors (primary: #2C5F2D forest green, secondary: #97BC62 moss green, accent: #F5F5F5 cream). The deck should have: title slide, problem statement, solution overview, market opportunity (with chart from CSV data), business model, financial projections (quarterly revenue chart), team introduction (photos + bios), competitive analysis, and funding ask. Make sure to remove any placeholder content and ensure the financial chart uses our brand colors. The final presentation should look polished and investor-ready.
